items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: That was Horace Henderson's little group; they called themselves the Wilberforcians.

ctx.x: Well, no, not too much. He didn't ...(? )... He was one of the first bands I had ever heard anywhere. Because I had seen people ...(? )...; you know what I mean, sort of playing for a dance or something. I remembered seeing him years ago. There used to be a band out of Wilberforce called The Wilberforcians, and that had... That was Horace Henderson's little group; they called themselves the Wilberforcians. And they used to come in town and play, too, you know -- in my town; this is Xenia. Then another band that…
That's what became McKinney's Cotton Pickers.
